summary: Blue Owl Real Estate Net Lease Trust filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 10,872,543 common shares for ~$115.9M gross proceeds at NAV ($10.66/share). It also declared routine monthly distributions ($0.0625/share gross, net of servicing fees). The share sale was exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D/S. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event; the filing is a routine capital raise and distribution declaration. No risk-arb angle or structural complexity applies.
